title: Canada regional outcomes assessment
basis: Transcribed from the reviewed 3 November 2026 seven-topic assessment; source checks do not automatically revise these findings.

ON.name: Ontario
ON.summary: Mixed: operating gains and employment pressure
ON.limitation: Chinese EV import access does not establish Canadian assembly jobs. These employer and industry measures cannot be added into a provincial net-jobs estimate.

BC.name: British Columbia
BC.summary: Operating gains: LNG exports and existing jobs
BC.limitation: The operating benefit is local project evidence. A net B.C.-wide gain caused by the 2026 arrangements has not been quantified.

AB.name: Alberta
AB.limitation: The national indicators show relevant trade channels. Province-specific shipment gains, completed investment and jobs caused by the new arrangements remain unquantified.

QC.name: Quebec
QC.limitation: An existing industrial position is not a gain created by a new agreement. No provincial financial-services gain or loss is inferred from one company’s overseas results.

SK.name: Saskatchewan
SK.limitation: Prairie producers and processors are exposed to these changes. National volumes are not allocated to this province, and new provincial jobs have not been established.

MB.name: Manitoba

records.title: Motor vehicles and parts export value
records.summary: Nominal export value to all markets changed -7.8% year over year.
records.limitation: All destinations; price, exchange-rate and product-mix changes are not isolated. Not a provincial or deal-attributable estimate.

records.title: Farm, fishing and intermediate food export value
records.summary: Nominal export value to all markets changed +8.1% year over year.
records.limitation: All destinations; price, exchange-rate and product-mix changes are not isolated. Not a provincial or deal-attributable estimate.

records.title: Energy products export value
records.summary: Nominal export value to all markets changed +35.7% year over year.
records.limitation: All destinations; price, exchange-rate and product-mix changes are not isolated. Not a provincial or deal-attributable estimate.

records.title: Canadian goods exports to China
records.summary: Export value to China rose 39.3% year over year.
records.limitation: The period ends before the September U.S.–China framework. Nominal growth does not establish additional Canadian value added or causation.

records.title: Canadian goods exports to United States
records.summary: Export value to United States rose 7.6% year over year.
records.limitation: The period ends before the September U.S.–China framework. Nominal growth does not establish additional Canadian value added or causation.

records.title: Canola seed shipments to China
records.summary: 2,581,011 tonnes of Canadian canola seed were exported to China.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

series.note: March 1 tariff change is a timing marker, not a causal estimate.

records.title: Canola seed shipments to United States
records.summary: 242,489 tonnes of Canadian canola seed were exported to United States.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

records.title: Canola meal shipments to China
records.summary: 1,073,608 tonnes of Canadian canola meal were exported to China.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

series.note: March 1 tariff change is a timing marker, not a causal estimate.

records.title: Canola meal shipments to United States
records.summary: 3,065,721 tonnes of Canadian canola meal were exported to United States.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

records.title: Canola oil shipments to China
records.summary: 1 tonnes of Canadian canola oil were exported to China.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

records.title: Canola oil shipments to United States
records.summary: 1,988,074 tonnes of Canadian canola oil were exported to United States.
records.limitation: Realized national customs volume; not assigned to any Prairie province. A shipment level alone is not an incremental policy effect.

records.title: Completed Canadian canola processing
records.summary: Domestic canola crush reached 12.89 million tonnes, up 13% year over year.
records.limitation: Completed processing output is not completed capital spending or a count of new jobs.

records.title: Completed canola seed exports
records.summary: Seed exports totalled 8.96 million tonnes, down about 5% year over year.
records.limitation: National crop-year total to all destinations; different period from January–August figures.

records.title: U.S. share of Canadian canola oil exports
records.summary: The U.S. received 89.1% of Canadian canola oil export volume.
records.limitation: Calculated from destination/world volumes. Dependence indicator, not an estimated tariff loss.

records.title: U.S. share of Canadian canola meal exports
records.summary: The U.S. received 70.2% of Canadian canola meal export volume.
records.limitation: Calculated from destination/world volumes. Dependence indicator, not an estimated tariff loss.

records.title: Canola seed tariff in China
records.summary: Combined canola-seed tariff reported at 14.9% after the implemented change.
records.limitation: Product-specific applied treatment. Verify tariff lines and current applicability.

records.title: Specified seafood and agricultural tariff relief
records.summary: Specified additional tariffs on canola meal, peas, lobster and crab suspended through year-end.
records.limitation: Improved access is established; province-specific shipment, investment and job gains are unquantified.

records.title: China EV quota utilization
records.summary: 16,206 units of the 49,000-unit annual quota utilized (33.1%).
records.limitation: Administrative quota/permit use is not a customs-clearance, retail-sale or Canadian manufacturing measure.

records.title: Within-quota Chinese EV tariff
records.summary: Within-quota tariff set at 6.1%; permits are administered under the import notice.
records.limitation: Imported finished vehicles do not establish Canadian component content, assembly investment or jobs.

records.title: Vehicles exported to the U.S.
records.summary: Canadian vehicle export value to the U.S. fell 9.6% in 2025.
records.limitation: Pre-2026 baseline; distinguish assembly from parts.

records.title: Auto-assembly payroll supported by U.S. demand
records.summary: U.S. demand supported 76.4% of Canadian auto-assembly payroll employment.
records.limitation: Input-output-supported jobs are not new 2026 jobs. Gross exports include imported inputs.

records.title: NextStar completed investment
records.summary: NextStar reports over C$5 billion invested and 10 million cells produced.
records.limitation: Existing LG/Stellantis-origin project; not a result of Chinese EV import access. Company-reported spending is kept separate from FDI stocks.

records.title: NextStar operating workforce
records.summary: About 1,300 operating employees at the Windsor battery plant.
records.limitation: Company-reported existing workforce, not 1,300 jobs created by a new China/U.S. arrangement. Cannot be netted against the GM layoff share.

records.title: GM represented workforce on layoff
records.summary: Unifor reported about 30% of its GM Canada members on layoff.
records.limitation: Union-reported share at Ontario facilities, not the provincial unemployment rate or an attributable tariff-loss count.

records.title: U.S. covered vehicle tariff
records.summary: Covered vehicle tariff is 25%, with U.S.-content relief for qualifying CUSMA vehicles; qualifying parts currently exempt.
records.limitation: Coverage, origin and content rules matter. This is not a flat 25% duty on every Canadian vehicle and part.

records.title: China share of Canadian LNG volume
records.summary: China received 18% of Canadian LNG export volume.
records.limitation: National volume share, not B.C. revenue or the effect of a 2026 MOU.

records.title: Crude oil delivered to the U.S.
records.summary: Canada delivered about 3.9 million barrels per day to the U.S., around 90% of crude exports.
records.limitation: National trade context; not an Alberta-only outcome.

records.title: U.S. share of Canadian crude exports
records.summary: Approximately 90% of Canadian crude exports went to the U.S.; non-U.S. share rose from about 2% in 2021 to 10% in 2025.
records.limitation: Existing physical diversification, not wholly China-directed or caused by a new agreement.

records.title: LNG Canada Phase 1 operating capacity
records.summary: Phase 1 is operating; PetroChina holds 15% of the multi-country joint venture.
records.limitation: Operations predate the 2026 MOU. Total completed capital spending is not allocated to individual partner countries.

records.title: LNG Canada operating workforce
records.summary: Over 400 permanent full-time operating jobs in Kitimat.
records.limitation: Company-reported existing workforce. Not all new in 2026 or attributable to China.

records.title: LNG Canada Phase 2 investment decision
records.summary: Phase 2 reached a final investment decision.
records.limitation: Additional trains are not completed capacity. Forecast production, jobs and tax receipts excluded from realized gains.

records.title: Manulife mainland China new-business CSM
records.summary: New-business CSM was C$183 million versus C$196 million, down 6.6% on the constant-FX basis.
records.limitation: CSM estimates future profit on new contracts. It is not Canadian cross-border service exports or domestic employment.

records.title: Manulife U.S. core earnings
records.summary: U.S. core earnings were US$459 million versus US$392 million, up 17% on the reported constant-FX basis.
records.limitation: Company-specific non-GAAP result. Different currency and metric from China new-business CSM; do not compare bar heights or add them.

records.title: FDI stock: ultimate investor United States
records.summary: C$816.8 billion book-value inward FDI stock by ultimate investor.
records.limitation: Stock includes acquisitions, reinvestment and valuation effects. It is not completed 2026 factory spending. China excludes separately reported Hong Kong.

records.title: FDI stock: ultimate investor China
records.summary: C$43.4 billion book-value inward FDI stock by ultimate investor.
records.limitation: Stock includes acquisitions, reinvestment and valuation effects. It is not completed 2026 factory spending. China excludes separately reported Hong Kong.

records.title: U.S.-source FDI inflow
records.summary: U.S.-source FDI inflow was C$52.9 billion.
records.limitation: Earlier-period net financial flow; not completed greenfield capex.

records.title: TikTok national-security review
records.summary: Further review concluded with conditional permission and legally binding undertakings.
records.limitation: Implemented regulatory decision, not measured new investment dollars, jobs or security benefits.

records.title: Financial Working Group meeting
records.summary: Canada–China Financial Working Group held its first meeting.
records.limitation: A meeting does not establish new operating licences, delivered services or Canadian jobs.

records.title: U.S. specified Canadian product duties
records.summary: Specified Canadian products face Section 338 additional duties, including covered CUSMA-origin goods; product coverage changed October 30.
records.limitation: Product-specific scope and exclusions must be checked. Do not extend this rate to every Canadian export.

records.title: CUSMA review and extension uncertainty
records.summary: The 2026 review did not secure a new 16-year extension; annual reviews continue.
records.limitation: An access-risk indicator, not current agreement termination or a measured job-loss total.

records.title: Canada–China cooperation roadmap
records.summary: Cooperation mechanisms and an energy MOU support dialogue.
records.limitation: Signed MOUs are not completed capital spending or realized supplier orders. Existing LNG operations began earlier.

records.title: U.S.–China 30-for-30 framework
records.summary: Framework values refer to 2024 bilateral U.S.–China trade.
records.limitation: Not new capital spending in Canada. August Canadian trade data cannot establish outcomes from this later framework.

records.title: Defence exports to the U.S.
records.summary: Exports to the U.S. were C$5.006 billion versus C$4.432 billion in 2022, up 13.0%.
records.limitation: 2026 publication measures 2024 activity. Asia/Oceania grouping cannot be relabelled China.

records.title: Canadian-based defence suppliers
records.summary: Canadian-based suppliers provided 53% of the defence industry supply chain.
records.limitation: Historical domestic participation, not new content produced by a 2026 agreement.

records.title: Quebec defence employment share

records.title: Atlantic defence employment share

methods: Unknown means not established in this review, not zero impact.
Regional relevance is not a provincial allocation of a national figure.
Gross exports, domestic value added, affiliate earnings, permits, FDI stocks and completed capital spending are distinct measures.
Operating headcounts, layoff percentages, broad labour estimates and model-supported jobs cannot be netted across incompatible definitions.
Policy status is independent of commercial outcome status. A signed MOU is not an implemented tariff or a realized gain.
A causal effect requires an appropriate comparison and controls for prices, exchange rates, seasonality, production and other policy shocks.
Daily monitoring preserves reviewed values and flags changed sources for review. Detection date, effective date, source publication and reference period remain separate.
